hooks.command: bun "$HOME/dotfiles/bin/codex-session-start-agent-note.ts"
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex SessionStart; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex SessionStart; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex PreToolUse
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex PreToolUse; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex PostToolUse
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex PostToolUse; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex PermissionRequest
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex PermissionRequest; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex PermissionRequest; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex Stop
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex Stop; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex Stop; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex UserPromptSubmit
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex UserPromptSubmit; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex UserPromptSubmit; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex SubagentStart
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex SubagentStart; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex SubagentStart; else cat >/dev/null; fi
vde-monitor-hook codex SubagentStop
if [ -n "$TMUX" ]; then vt hook codex SubagentStop; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex SubagentStop; else cat >/dev/null; fi
if [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] && command -v vte >/dev/null; then vte hook codex SessionEnd; else cat >/dev/null; fi
